name: Birthdays
overview: Scripture acknowledges the occasion of birthdays, as seen in Genesis 40:20 where Pharaoh's birthday was marked with a feast. While celebrating birthdays is not extensively detailed, the Psalms encourage believers to seek joy and delight in the Lord, who grants the desires of the heart and provides fullness of joy in His presence (Psalms 16:11, 20:4, 37:4). Additionally, Psalm 90:12 reminds us to number our days wisely, suggesting a God-centered perspective on life’s milestones. The blessing of the Lord to keep and protect His people (Numbers 6:24) underscores the importance of relying on God's grace throughout all seasons of life.
